the molecular biology of Bacteroidaceae, with a particular emphasis on the pathogenesis and epidemiology of ovine foot rot, a major disease of sheep in Australia, the United Kingdom and elsewhere.
the molecular biology of the pathogenic bacterium B. nodosus, which is the cause of ovine foot rot and a serious disease in sheep.
the molecular basis of ovine foot rot, a bacterial disease that affects sheep and is caused by the gram-negative bacterium Bacteroides Nodosus.

the nucleotide sequence encoding a pilin gene from Bacteroidaceae is similar to that encoding the pilin gene of Neisseriaceae, but the sequence of the pilin gene from the two genera is not homologous.

the pilus from this important pathogen is a homopolymer of a single protein subunit, and the pilin gene is a member of the family of pilin genes which are widely distributed among gram-negative bacteria and which encode pilin proteins which share a high degree of amino acid sequence homology.
